cues: In light, silver chloride slowly turns violet, then grey, as it decomposes to silver and chlorine.
That light sensitivity is the whole basis of film photography and of self darkening spectacle lenses.
Silver chloride is also used in the silver silver chloride reference electrode inside pH probes and E C G pads.
